backdating.distance_since_genuine_entry_m: horizontal craft-center distance from the interpolated original crossing through commitment and onward; the committed ENTERED and later TRAVERSED records retain that backdated distance origin
backdating.entry_tick: the later tick of the original outside-to-inside crossing pair; never the later commitment tick

classification.candidate_cancel: reset/teleport, junction override, a different candidate winning the total tie-break, or leaving the candidate entry-inset envelope before commitment clears candidate tick/time/distance
classification.candidate_crossing_point: linear interpolation of the consecutive craft-center samples at the entry-inset boundary; ties use the route tie-break before interpolation
classification.candidate_distance: horizontal craft-center polyline distance from the interpolated crossing point through every subsequent candidate sample; distance before the crossing point is excluded
classification.candidate_start: only a continuous non-teleport pair whose earlier sample is outside the winning route entry-inset envelope (or is classified junction/base/another route) and whose later sample is inside; the first post-boundary sample establishes prior state and cannot start a candidate
classification.commit: commit on the first physics tick where continuous candidate time is at least 0.25 s and candidate distance is at least 2.0 m
classification.exit: the committed route remains current until junction override or three consecutive physics ticks outside that route exit-outset envelope; the exit effective tick is the third outside tick and no exit backdating occurs
classification.first_post_boundary_sample: establish previous craft-center/classification state only; cannot create candidate, ENTERED, TRAVERSED, or GATE_CROSSED credit
classification.sample_point: craft global-position x,z after the normal physics movement for the tick and before telemetry emission

collision_interface.collapse_rule: emit at most one COLLISION_SAMPLE per (physics_tick, source_geometry_id), regardless of contact-point or slide-iteration count
collision_interface.contact_source: contacts reported by the frozen craft movement/collision path during the normal physics tick; test code must not add movement or collision response
collision_interface.counted_hard_collision: one collapsed COLLISION_SAMPLE on a hard_geometry_id during the vector counting window; HOP_BAR_01 is hard-Hop, the other four IDs are hard/non-Hop
collision_interface.counting_window: first normal physics tick after initial spawn/reset completion through vector termination tick inclusive; for RT_HOP_SUCCESS, termination is the first valid bounded HOP_BAR_HJE_CLEAR completion tick; HOP_PRESS and HOP_RELEASE do not alter the window
collision_interface.excluded: heightfield/road support contacts and trigger-only gate/route areas are not hard collisions
collision_interface.hard_collision_count: count of COLLISION_SAMPLE records whose source_geometry_id is any hard_geometry_id
collision_interface.non_hop_hard_collision_count: same count after excluding source_geometry_id HOP_BAR_01

gate_event.name: GATE_CROSSED
gate_event.rule: continuous non-teleport consecutive craft-center samples change CORE_REGION containment and their segment crosses CORE_BOUNDARY inside exactly one named aperture

HOP_BAR_CLEARANCE_SAMPLE.sampling: every tick whose conservative craft plan footprint overlaps the bar footprint

HOP_CLEARANCE_COMPLETION.boundary: first valid bounded HOP_BAR_HJE_CLEAR crossing after support readiness, ordered Hop command/start, plan-overlap clearance, and zero hard collision through the completion tick inclusive

impact_interface.movement_effect: none; existing impact_count and last_impact fields remain byte-identical and behavior-identical
impact_interface.queue: bounded append-only ring of 256 samples; observers drain copies; overflow emits dropped_count; appended after existing velocity write

plane_evidence.bar_span: HOP_BAR_SPAN_PENETRATION is associated with canonical HOP_BAR_01 containment/boundary evidence and covers z=126..144
plane_evidence.continuous_crossing_rule: one crossing is counted when consecutive non-teleport samples change from signed_distance < 0 to signed_distance >= 0; a sample exactly on zero can complete only one crossing until a later negative sample re-arms it
plane_evidence.end_bypass: north/south end windows are finite HJW-to-HJE crossing windows outside the bar span and intentionally have no bar-containment/proximity requirement
plane_evidence.reset_and_teleport: clear window history; the first later sample establishes prior signed distance and cannot count
plane_evidence.v1_2_4a_split: supported Hop clearance, direct non-Hop BAR_SPAN/HJE_CLEAR denial, and north/south END_BYPASS denial are separate claims; end crossings never require bar containment.
plane_evidence.v1_2_4b_split: Four isolated claims: support-ready timed Hop clearance; direct powered non-Hop span denial; north legal seam denial; south legal seam denial. Static end closure is separately bound to world/generated/hop_gate_end_seals.json.

rules.ENTERED: emitted at the commitment tick only after the exact candidate hysteresis contract; entry_tick, crossing point, and distance backdate to the original genuine crossing
rules.SPAWNED: emitted when teleport/reset ends inside a route envelope; grants no entry or traversal credit
rules.TRAVERSED: emitted only for the genuinely entered route when its destination junction is reached; a test runner must match the requested route_id and may not terminate on another route traversal

terminal_runtime_result_boundary.events_after_result: INVALID AUTHORITATIVE EVIDENCE; preserve separately and classify BLOCKED/NOT TESTABLE
order: disable craft and telemetry physics processing

test_driver_liveness_event.every_tick_rule: required for the two powered end attempts and direct non-Hop span vector; contiguous vector ticks with no omissions

test_driver_route_projection_event.fail_fast: after the first unauthorized hard collision is observed and recorded, the vector ends with FIRST_UNAUTHORIZED_HARD_COLLISION
test_driver_route_projection_event.name: TEST_DRIVER_ROUTE_PROJECTION
test_driver_route_projection_event.sampling: after each normal physics tick for V5 fast-route vectors
test_driver_route_projection_event.threshold_binding: maximum_test_driver_path_deviation_m equals the maximum route_lateral_distance_m from these records; liveness defaults cannot satisfy it

v7_phase_separation_invariant: commanded_throttle and commanded_brake may not both be positive in any projection record
